data: independent 64 stress pairs only; pilot not pooled
scope: fixed equal-weight eight-case benchmark; not a human-strength probability

review.no_rest: 18 to 23 wins; 10 better, 5 worse, 17 same pairs

review.controls: Both on-pool pairs have identical full trajectories
review.prior_sensitivity: P(improve) ranges from 81.03% at mass 0.5 to 61.41% at mass 64; mass 4 is 76.53%. Adoption uses only the frozen mass-1 criterion.
review.mechanism: Four improved Snorlax/Umbreon no-Rest pairs first change Pursuit to Toxic against Machamp. This is a whole-policy benchmark improvement, not isolated evidence for anticipating the lead Rest move.

deployment: not deployed; published version remains EarlyPerish

subsequent_review.action: Restore EarlyPerish as the local default; preserve this confirmation result as historical evidence.
